translation.english_text: (Punnakodi and several workers are sitting after having refreshments.)
You cannot find a motherly man like Paranthaman even if you search while eating. For good conduct and upright behaviour, our Paranthaman alone is the one and only example.
You're praising him, but your own son has written 'The False Leader.'
The boy writes—he's lost his sense. Is he my son? He's a traitor.
Keep quiet. Pandiyan goes on exposing falsehood and showing the way of reason—he is a servant of truth.
notes: The verified Tamil is irregular in this sentence; the translation follows its supported sense without rewriting the Tamil source.

translation.english_text: They say they're even going to make a film called 'The False Leader.'

They will, they will! First this cinema itself must disappear. [Source wording irregular.] Marriage in the house. Poor thing, no marriage. An old man getting married? All this is cinema. When will this cinema disappear?
notes: A short phrase in the verified Tamil is textually irregular and is not silently reconstructed.

translation.english_text: Why, is it attacking you personally?
Hey, why do labourers need motion pictures!
For a man who has worked hard all day, cinema is at least a little relief. Isn't that enough—why object to it?
notes: The source line contains irregular wording; this renders only the sense supported by the surrounding sentence.

translation.english_text: Oh, wonderful. Let this power cut spread all over the world so that cinema itself disappears.
Look at that noble thought! For cinema to disappear, he'd even have it rain until the whole town dies!
notes: The printed line is irregular; no correction has been made to the canonical Tamil.

translation.english_text: Who's old, eh?.... I'll thrash you. These fellows seem to belong to Pandiyan's group. He said the same thing. Old, am I? Old age! This is like Palani panchamirtham....
notes: The final source wording is irregular; the recognizable Palani panchamirtham reference is retained without supplying missing words.
